purpose: Require an explicit versioned research adequacy review before a structurally valid general-face corpus can satisfy Face Space normalization coverage gates.
rules: Structural validity alone does not establish general-face or reference-distribution adequacy.
Adequacy must be linked to the exact reference-split fingerprint, provider pin, and sampling-frame provenance.
No numeric minimum sample threshold is invented by this contract.
Automatic adequacy inference from record count is forbidden.
Coverage limitations must be explicitly documented.
Adequacy grants provisional research gating only and no Production normalization authority.
The adequacy decision must be bound to a descriptive reference-corpus review packet generated from the exact corpus.
The review packet must exclude center/scale statistics, percentiles, and holdout measurement values so it cannot become a method-selection or calibration artifact.
The review packet must preserve the research privacy boundary: no persisted source image, raw landmarks, identity embeddings, biometric matching, or local image paths.
